meanings.definitionEn: a time of rest from work, school etc.
meanings.exampleEn: Where did you go during the holiday?
meanings.exampleCn: 假期你去了哪里？

meanings.definitionEn: at, in, or to what place or position
meanings.exampleEn: Where is the nearest bus stop?
meanings.exampleCn: 最近的公交站在哪里？

meanings.definitionEn: throughout the entire time of an event or period
meanings.exampleEn: She remained silent during the meeting.
meanings.exampleCn: 会议期间她保持沉默。

meanings.definitionEn: an electronic device for storing and processing data
meanings.exampleEn: I use my computer for online research.
meanings.exampleCn: 我用电脑做在线调研。

meanings.definitionEn: pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically
meanings.exampleEn: The sunrise this morning was truly beautiful.
meanings.exampleCn: 今晨的日出非常美丽。

meanings.definitionEn: of great significance or value
meanings.exampleEn: Health is the most important thing in life.
meanings.exampleCn: 健康是人生中最重要的东西。

meanings.definitionEn: an institution for educating children
meanings.exampleEn: He walks to school every weekday morning.
meanings.exampleCn: 他每个工作日早晨都走路去上学。

meanings.definitionEn: a person who teaches, especially in a school
meanings.exampleEn: Our teacher explains grammar clearly.
meanings.exampleCn: 我们的老师把语法讲得很透彻。

meanings.definitionEn: a person who is studying at a school or college
meanings.exampleEn: Every student in the class passed the exam.
meanings.exampleCn: 班里每个学生都通过了考试。

meanings.definitionEn: a group of one or more parents and their children living together
meanings.exampleEn: Family dinner is our weekend tradition.
meanings.exampleCn: 全家共进晚餐是我们的周末传统。

meanings.definitionEn: a person whom one knows and with whom one has a bond of mutual affection
meanings.exampleEn: A true friend is always by your side.
meanings.exampleCn: 真正的朋友总是在你身边。

meanings.definitionEn: the period of time between sunrise and noon
meanings.exampleEn: I like reading English in the early morning.
meanings.exampleCn: 我喜欢在清晨读英语。

meanings.definitionEn: the time between midday and the evening
meanings.exampleEn: Let us have a cup of tea this afternoon.
meanings.exampleCn: 今天下午我们喝杯茶吧。

meanings.definitionEn: the period of time at the end of the day
meanings.exampleEn: We took a quiet walk in the evening.
meanings.exampleCn: 我们在傍晚安静地散了步。

meanings.definitionEn: the warmest season of the year
meanings.exampleEn: Summer is the best season for swimming.
meanings.exampleCn: 夏天是游泳的最佳季节。

meanings.definitionEn: the coldest season of the year
meanings.exampleEn: Snow covered the mountain in winter.
meanings.exampleCn: 冬天的积雪覆盖了山峰。

meanings.definitionEn: make a journey, typically of some length
meanings.exampleEn: I love to travel to different countries.
meanings.exampleCn: 我喜欢去不同的国家旅行。

meanings.definitionEn: a nation with its own government, occupying a particular territory
meanings.exampleEn: China is a country with rich history.
meanings.exampleCn: 中国是一个历史悠久的国家。

meanings.definitionEn: a large town
meanings.exampleEn: Shanghai is a bustling modern city.
meanings.exampleCn: 上海是一座繁华的现代大都市。

meanings.definitionEn: a sentence worded or expressed so as to elicit information
meanings.exampleEn: Please raise your hand if you have a question.
meanings.exampleCn: 如果你有问题，请举手。

meanings.definitionEn: the state of the atmosphere at a place and time
meanings.exampleEn: The weather is warm and sunny today.
meanings.exampleCn: 今天天气温暖晴朗。

meanings.definitionEn: perform an activity repeatedly to improve skill
meanings.exampleEn: Practice makes perfect.
meanings.exampleCn: 熟能生巧。

meanings.definitionEn: the method of human communication using words
meanings.exampleEn: English is an international language.
meanings.exampleCn: 英语是一门国际语言。

meanings.definitionEn: facts, information, and skills acquired through experience or education
meanings.exampleEn: Knowledge is power.
meanings.exampleCn: 知识就是力量。

meanings.definitionEn: a building or room containing collections of books for reading
meanings.exampleEn: I borrow books from the school library.
meanings.exampleCn: 我从学校图书馆借书。

meanings.definitionEn: forward or onward movement toward a destination or goal
meanings.exampleEn: You are making steady progress in English.
meanings.exampleCn: 你的英语正在取得稳步进展。

meanings.definitionEn: the faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information
meanings.exampleEn: Spaced repetition boosts memory retention.
meanings.exampleCn: 间隔重复能显著提升记忆保留率。

meanings.definitionEn: a set of words that is complete in itself, typically containing a subject and predicate
meanings.exampleEn: Write down a complete English sentence.
meanings.exampleCn: 写下一个完整的英语句子。

meanings.definitionEn: a book or electronic resource that lists words and their meanings
meanings.exampleEn: Look up unknown words in the dictionary.
meanings.exampleCn: 在词典中查生词。

meanings.definitionEn: activity requiring physical or mental effort
meanings.exampleEn: Regular exercise keeps your body fit.
meanings.exampleCn: 定期锻炼能保持身体健康。

meanings.definitionEn: give one’s attention to a sound
meanings.exampleEn: Listen carefully to the teacher’s pronunciation.
meanings.exampleCn: 仔细听老师的发音。

meanings.definitionEn: say something in order to convey information or an opinion
meanings.exampleEn: Can you speak English fluently?
meanings.exampleCn: 你能流利说英语吗？

meanings.definitionEn: look at and comprehend the meaning of written matter
meanings.exampleEn: I read an English chapter every night.
meanings.exampleCn: 我每晚读一章英语。

meanings.definitionEn: mark on a surface with a pen, pencil, or other instrument
meanings.exampleEn: Write your thoughts in an English journal.
meanings.exampleCn: 把你的想法写在英语日记里。

meanings.definitionEn: gain knowledge of or skill in something
meanings.exampleEn: It is never too late to learn.
meanings.exampleCn: 活到老，学到老。

meanings.definitionEn: view or inspect again; examine
meanings.exampleEn: Review the new words before going to sleep.
meanings.exampleCn: 睡前复习一下生词。

meanings.definitionEn: acquire complete knowledge or skill in
meanings.exampleEn: You can master 500 core words this month.
meanings.exampleCn: 你本月可以掌握500个核心词。

meanings.definitionEn: successfully bring about or reach by effort
meanings.exampleEn: Work hard and you will achieve your dreams.
meanings.exampleCn: 努力工作，你就能实现梦想。

meanings.definitionEn: the accomplishment of an aim or purpose
meanings.exampleEn: Persistence is key to learning success.
meanings.exampleCn: 坚持是学习成功的关键。

meanings.definitionEn: a vigorous or determined attempt
meanings.exampleEn: Every small effort counts toward your goal.
meanings.exampleCn: 每一次微小的努力都会助你达成目标。

meanings.definitionEn: a call to take part in a contest or fight; difficult task
meanings.exampleEn: Accept the challenge with confidence.
meanings.exampleCn: 自信地迎接挑战。

meanings.definitionEn: travel in or through in order to learn about it
meanings.exampleEn: Let us explore new ways of learning English.
meanings.exampleCn: 让我们探索学习英语的新方法。

meanings.definitionEn: find unexpectedly or in the course of a search
meanings.exampleEn: You will discover many interesting phrases here.
meanings.exampleCn: 你会在这里发现很多有趣的短语。

meanings.definitionEn: desire or be curious to know something
meanings.exampleEn: I wonder what happens next in the story.
meanings.exampleCn: 我想知道故事接下去会发生什么。

meanings.definitionEn: easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty
meanings.exampleEn: Keep your sentences simple and clear.
meanings.exampleCn: 保持句子简单清晰。

meanings.definitionEn: the time that will come after the present
meanings.exampleEn: Invest in your future by learning today.
meanings.exampleCn: 通过今天的学习投资你的未来。

meanings.definitionEn: the season after winter and before summer
meanings.exampleEn: Flowers begin to bloom in early spring.
meanings.exampleCn: 早春时节鲜花盛开。

meanings.definitionEn: the season between summer and winter
meanings.exampleEn: Golden leaves fall gently in autumn.
meanings.exampleCn: 秋天金黄的树叶轻轻飘落。

meanings.definitionEn: an act of traveling from one place to another
meanings.exampleEn: A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
meanings.exampleCn: 千里之行，始于足下。

meanings.definitionEn: each of the four divisions of the year
meanings.exampleEn: Which season do you like best?
meanings.exampleCn: 你最喜欢哪个季节？
